verdict.rationale: Cal.com docs state that every booking gets a location, which defaults to Cal Video (native video) and can be pointed at Zoom, Microsoft Teams or Google Meet once the app is connected. Native video is reaffirmed in the product overview, and the app store lists further video options such as Jitsi. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that links are generated reliably for every booking, detailed docs on per-event-type default location configuration.
